evals.prompt: The runnable project in evals/files/port-collision intermittently fails with EADDRINUSE when its repository suite runs in parallel. Make the test reliable, run the focused test, and explain the evidence it needs.
evals.expected_output: The test allocates the port through the listener itself, reads the assigned address after readiness, and does not fall back to a scan-then-bind race or global serialization.
assertions: The response identifies the scan-then-bind race as the cause.
The pre-fix fixture fails deterministically with EADDRINUSE.
The fix uses the listener's atomic port allocation and waits for readiness.
The response rejects global serialization and an unexplained timeout increase.
The edited project's focused test passes.

evals.prompt: Review the runnable project in evals/files/global-state. The test passes alone but changes behavior when another test runs first. Make the fixture safe under parallel and possibly repeated execution, then run its focused suite.
evals.expected_output: The fixture captures absent-versus-present global state, restores it exactly through immediate cleanup and a fallback, and proves the original clock and environment are restored.
assertions: The response distinguishes an absent environment entry from one restored to an empty or string value.
Restoration is registered immediately and includes a fallback after an early failure.
The response restores real timers and verifies the restored state.
The focused suite passes after the fix.

evals.prompt: Tell me why evals/files/diagnosis-only/ci.log fails intermittently. Do not change code, workflows, or rerun CI; I only need the supported diagnosis, separation of timeout and signal evidence, the smallest relevant reproduction, and remaining limits.
evals.expected_output: The response preserves the read-only scope, separates timeout and signal evidence, classifies the repeated host-resource signature, names the smallest relevant reproduction and its limits, and makes no code or CI change.
assertions: The response makes no code, workflow, rerun, or configuration change.
The response cites the repeated EADDRINUSE signature across unrelated jobs.
The response separates timeout expiry from signal termination.
The response names the smallest relevant reproduction.
The response states that host metrics are unavailable and identifies the remaining reproduction limit.

evals.prompt: The runnable project in evals/files/slow-suite repeats the same expensive fixture for every case and in both Node matrix lanes; the proposed patch multiplies three timeout groups by three. Redesign the tests rather than enlarging timeouts, edit the project, and run the suite.
evals.expected_output: The revision keeps fast contract cases separate, runs one shared expensive representative scenario, avoids repeating external work where compatibility cannot change the result, and uses timeouts only as named watchdogs.
assertions: The revision removes repeated expensive fixture setup instead of increasing all group timeouts.
Fast contract cases remain separate from the one shared expensive scenario.
The expensive check is not duplicated across lanes where its result cannot differ.
The edited project's test entry passes.
